entities.summary: Petrus Josephus Zoetmulder S.J. was an Indonesian expert in the Old Javanese language. He came from Utrecht and was associated with the Society of Jesus by 1925. He worked at Leiden University in the 1930s. His first work appeared in 1930 and he continued to write into the 1990s. He lived in Yogyakarta and was interred in the Jesuit necropolis at Muntilan, Java. Petrus Josephus Zoetmulder was a physicians & medical pioneers from Utrecht (1906-01-29, Utrecht–1995-07-08). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
